psionic_energy_dice.description: A pool of psionic dice powering your subclass features. You regain 1 die on a Short Rest and all dice on a Long Rest. Only Soulknife features may use these dice.

features.psi_bolstered_knack: When you fail an ability check using a proficient skill or tool, roll a Psionic Energy Die and add it. The die is expended only if this turns the failure into success.
features.psychic_whispers: Magic Action: Choose up to PB creatures and roll a Psionic Energy Die. For hours equal to the roll, you and chosen creatures communicate telepathically within 1 mile. First use each Long Rest does not expend the die; all later uses do.

psychic_blades.description: You manifest blades of pure psychic energy. Used when you take the Attack action or make an Opportunity Attack.

weapon_stats.name: Psychic Blade
weapon_stats.bonus_action_attack: After attacking with the blade on your turn, you may create a second blade and make a melee or ranged attack as a Bonus Action (damage: 1d4 Psychic).

mastery.vex: If you hit and deal damage, you gain Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.
